Its masculine singular relative form fills the subject-link for {{ar:أَنقَضَ}} ({{tr:anqaḍa}}), so the burden itself becomes the grammatical cause in the clause. Its fused entry and lengthened ending give the boundary-opening relative marker audible carryover rather than a hard restart: the reader must bring the earlier noun forward before the damage can be understood.

words.prose: {{ar:أَنقَضَ}} ({{tr:anqaḍa}}) is the ayah's pressure point. As a Form IV perfect, it presents the damaging action as a completed fact and assigns causation to the prior burden: the load made the back crack or groan. The root's wider undoing and breach field, familiar from covenant-breaking uses (2:27; 13:25), is narrowed here by {{ar:ظَهْرَكَ}} ({{tr:ẓahraka}}) into bodily load-strain, so the abstract burden becomes audible structural damage like a load-bearing frame creaking under weight. The compact qaf-and-dad impact cluster concentrates that cracking or groaning sound at the clause center without replacing the grammatical frame.

topics.headline: causative verb makes the burden the damaging agent

topics.reason: QAC marks a Form IV perfect verb, and attachment evidence gives it a relative subject-link to the prior burden plus an explicit direct object.

topics.headline: perfect verb discloses completed harm

topics.reason: The perfect form presents the damage as accomplished, and the clause remains subordinate to the burden already named in 94:2.

topics.headline: cracking and groaning are both locally live
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb evokes both structural fracture and audible strain, making the burden's pressure perceptible rather than abstract.
topics.reason: The explicit object is a back, so the physical and auditory strain sense is locally licensed while more general undoing remains background.

topics.headline: breach-root background is narrowed into bodily damage
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a root familiar from undoing and covenant breach (2:27; 13:25) is unusually pressed into a physical back-cracking scene.
topics.reason: The broader root field supports undoing and breach pressure, but the local Form IV verb with a concrete back object selects bodily cracking or groaning rather than an actual covenant action.

words.prose: {{ar:ظَهْرَكَ}} ({{tr:ẓahraka}}) lands the clause on the addressee's own back, not on a generic body or a loose metaphor. The suffix binds the affected body part to the same addressee who had the prior burden, while the accusative object role makes the back the structure directly acted on. The noun's load-bearing range keeps the image concrete: this is the platform on which weight bears down, so damage to it also signals weakened backing capacity. At the same time, the root's support and manifestation field is only a controlled resonance; hidden pressure becomes visible through damage to the bearer, but the local word remains the singular concrete back. The final word also answers the earlier chest-opening body frame (94:1) with the burdened back and closes the opening arc with the repeated -aka sound.

topics.reason: V4 lists support and manifestation branches for the root, but QAC and attachment constrain the local form to a concrete possessed back as direct object.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. The direct image is a back audibly strained by a load. Lexical evidence: `ن ق ض B005` creaking under strain from joints, loads, saddles, or a burdened back; `ظ ه ر B002` anatomical back; 94:2 `و ز ر B002` heavy burden. Structural cue: the relative phrase in 94:3 specifies the `وزر` of 94:2 by its effect. Assigned role: `أنقض` supplies audible evidence of pressure; `ظهر` supplies the support surface. Abductive move supplied by me: sound is treated as the symptom of hidden load. Reading change: the ayah makes prior suffering materially audible, not merely conceptually heavy.

2. The burden also threatens the collapse of a constructed order. Lexical evidence: `ن ق ض B001` breaking or undoing what was made firm, such as rope, structure, covenant, oath, argument; `ظ ه ر B006/B016` backing/support and supporting people; `ر ب ب B011` covenant or pact as binding bundle. Structural cue: the passage later raises mention (94:4) and directs desire to the Lord (94:8), after the old support has been strained. Assigned role: `نقض` is undoing; `ظهر` is the system of backing. Abductive move supplied by me: a burden can break not only a body but the social/covenantal support on which a person stands. Reading change: the ayah reads as near-unraveling of support, not only back pain.

3. Travel-weariness enters through animal and road branches. Lexical evidence: `ن ق ض B002` a camel worn down by travel; `ظ ه ر B005` mounts and spare riding animals; `و ض ع B003` urging a mount into rapid travel; `ن ص ب B010` day-long easy march; `ف ر غ B003` breadth in a road. Structural cue: later 94:7 gives a post-relief imperative that can be read as renewed movement/labor. Assigned role: the back is also a mount/backing that has been overtraveled. Abductive move supplied by me: the strained back is a vehicle image for mission-fatigue, preparing for a different kind of onward travel. Reading change: the ayah becomes exhaustion from carrying a journey, not only static weight.

4. A disclosure reading is activated by `ظهر`. Lexical evidence: `ظ ه ر B001` coming out into view, `ظ ه ر B008` finding out/access to hidden matter, and `ش ر ح B001` opening what was hidden. Structural cue: 94:1 opens the chest; 94:3 names the back/surface; 94:4 raises mention into public view. Assigned role: the pressure on the back brings an invisible burden into manifestation. Abductive move supplied by me: what creaks becomes known; the body exposes what was hidden. Reading change: the ayah reads as revelation of hidden strain as well as the strain itself.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 94:7 retrospectively made the travel-worn animal branch of `ن ق ض B002` more visible: after the back has creaked, the command does not cancel movement but reorders it. 94:4 also surprised the reading of `ظهر`: the strained support is answered not merely by relief but by public elevation of `ذكر`, so hidden pressure becomes manifest honor. 94:8 strengthened the covenant/support reading by making `ر ب ب B011` available as a repaired binding relation after the old backing had nearly come undone.

1. **The back's sound as a diagnostic of hidden overload.** Fixed `ن ق ض/B005` is specifically the creaking or cracking of joints, saddles, loads, and a back under weight; fixed `ظ ه ر/B002` is the anatomical back. The antecedent in 94:2 is `و ز ر/B002`, a heavy burden, and 94:4-6 reverse pressure through raising and ease. The sound branch makes strain perceptible, while the back branch identifies the load-bearing surface. **Abductive move:** I infer that the audible symptom reveals a threshold of failure and motivates the unloading; causation is not grammatically asserted beyond the relative clause. **Reading change:** **أنقض** is not merely “undid” the back but makes overload audible, turning the ayah into a diagnosis.

2. **A transport body worn down by its journey.** Fixed `ن ق ض/B002` is a camel exhausted by travel, and fixed `ظ ه ر/B005` is a mount or load-bearing animal kept for travel. Around them, 94:2 offers `و ض ع/B003` rapid mounted travel, 94:5-6 offer `ي س ر/B005` light compliant movement, and 94:7 offers `ف ر غ/B003` breadth of gait plus `ن ص ب/B010` a sustained march; 94:8 supplies a destination. The fixed branches cast the back as transport capacity and its damage as journey-wear. **Abductive move:** I infer that these animal-motion branches describe one continuous traveler whose load is removed so movement can resume. **Reading change:** the ayah can portray exhausted conveyance, not only an injured human back, and the surah's later imperatives become resumed travel.

3. **Exploratory: attached liability falling away before public repair.** Fixed `ن ق ض/B001` is undoing what had been made firm, and fixed `ظ ه ر/B013` is the idiom of blame or defect ceasing to adhere to a person. The preceding **عنك وزرك** supplies separation from a burden that can include sin under `و ز ر/B002`; 94:4 then raises `ذ ك ر/B007`, honorable repute. The fixed branches supply undoing and non-adhering blame, while the adjacent ayat supply removal and restored standing. **Abductive move:** I infer moral liability -> detached blame -> repaired reputation; this is a form-distant activation because the fixed surface is the noun **ظهرك**, not the packet's idiom. **Reading change:** the broken-back image acquires a social-moral layer in which what clung to the person is undone before mention is elevated.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 94:4 made the social extension newly visible: raised `ذ ك ر/B007` can follow the falling-away of burden or blame, so bodily repair and public repair may run together. Farther on, 94:7-8 supplied broad gait, sustained march, and destination; these later cues unexpectedly activated the otherwise dormant `ن ق ض/B002` exhausted-camel and `ظ ه ر/B005` mount branches.

findings.text: Belin çıkardığı ses, görünmeyen yükün bedeni çökme sınırına getirdiğini duyulur kılan bir aşırı yüklenme belirtisidir.
Ağırlık, yalnız bedeni değil, kişiyi ayakta tutan toplumsal veya bağlılığa dayalı destek düzenini de çözülme noktasına getiren bir baskı kazanır.
Yolculuktan tükenmiş binek ve yük taşıyan sırt çağrışımları, ayeti uzun bir görevin yorduğu taşıma gücü olarak okutur; sonraki çaba ve yöneliş bu yolculuğun yeniden başlamasıdır.
Gıcırdayarak dışa vuran bel, içeride saklı kalan baskıyı görünür ve bilinir hâle getirir; bedensel ses aynı zamanda gizli sıkıntının açığa çıkışıdır.
Çözülme ve kişiye yapışmış kusurun düşmesi çağrışımları, kaldırılan yükü sonraki itibar onarımından önce ayrılan bir suçlama veya sorumluluk gibi gösterebilir.

butuncul_okuma_line.raw_line: **94:3.** ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ — Birincil okuma: Ayet, yük altında ses veren sırtı görünür ve duyulur kılar. Aynı kökler, bunun yalnız beden ağrısı değil, yolculuktan yorulmuş bir taşıyıcı, çözülmeye yaklaşmış bir destek düzeni ve saklı baskının açığa çıkması olduğunu da hissettirir; ardından gelen zikrin yükseltilmesi, bu gizli ezilmenin kamusal onura çevrildiğini gösterir. {ن ق ض B001; ن ق ض B002; ن ق ض B005; ظ ه ر B001; ظ ه ر B002; ظ ه ر B006; ظ ه ر B008; و ز ر B002; ر ف ع B002}
